user.title: DFES Emergency WA
user.description: Track Emergency WA incidents and warnings around a location. Incidents inside the tracking radius appear on the Home Assistant map.

data_description.radius: Incidents and warnings within this distance are mapped and counted.
data_description.alert_radius: The Fire nearby binary sensor turns on for fires (not burn offs) within this distance.
data_description.exclude_burn_offs: Hide planned burn offs completely (map, sensors and events).
data_description.fire_district: For the Fire danger rating sensors. Find yours on the Emergency WA Fire Danger Ratings page or the DFES list of districts by local council. Leave empty to skip.

error.outside_wa: That location isn't in Western Australia.

abort.already_configured: This location is already being tracked.

data_description.incidents_url: Only change this if Emergency WA moves its RSS feed.
data_description.warnings_url: Only change this if Emergency WA moves its RSS feed.
data_description.fire_district: For the Fire danger rating sensors. Find yours on the Emergency WA Fire Danger Ratings page or the DFES list of districts by local council. Leave empty to skip.
data_description.fdr_url: Only change this if Emergency WA moves its RSS feed.
data_description.track_aircraft: Show water bombers, helitacks, air attack, RAC Rescue, RFDS and police aircraft on the map, from the free adsb.lol / airplanes.live ADS-B feeds.
data_description.aircraft_radius: Emergency aircraft within this distance are mapped (up to 460 km).
data_description.aircraft_scan_interval: How often to fetch aircraft positions. Please keep it reasonable; the feeds are free community services.
data_description.aircraft_extra: Callsigns, registrations or ICAO hex codes to track as well, separated by commas or new lines (e.g. VH-ABC, 7C1234).
data_description.show_all_aircraft: Map every aircraft in the aircraft radius, not just emergency aircraft. Sensors, alerts and events still only count emergency aircraft.

serious_warning.name: Watch and Act or Emergency Warning

select_pin.name: Select map pin
select_pin.description: Shows an incident or warning in the Selected on map sensor, e.g. when its pin is tapped on a dashboard map.

pin.name: Map pin
pin.description: The DFES map pin (geo_location entity) to show.

clear_selection.name: Clear map selection
clear_selection.description: Clears the Selected on map sensor.

not_a_pin.message: {pin} is not a DFES Emergency WA map pin.
